review_warnings.s01.0: Claims '91 days for 210MW' is a record retrofit time, but the cited span C-3044098a3d0180 only says SpaceX cut 8-12-month build times in half; '91 days' is a specific retrofit figure, not framed as a record. Also 'building faster than any peer' and 'record retrofit times' are embellishments beyond the cited spans. Core figures (3.6GW, ~13GW 2027, 91 days/210MW) are supported.
review_warnings.s03.1: Label is FORECAST but line mixes a MEASURED OBSERVATION (91 days/210MW, actual) and a forecast (~4-5 month greenfield). The '~4-5 month greenfield' blends ~5 months (MiniHard, actual) and ~4 months (Gun Range, forecast); acceptable range. Label FORECAST is not stronger than content. Supported overall.
review_warnings.s06.0: Sentence names 'Project SPAM, Gun Range, Starbase' but cited spans only cover Gun Range (~4 months) and MiniHard substation (Dec 31 2026) plus an Oct 5 2026 start date; 'Project SPAM' and 'Starbase' are not in the cited spans.
review_warnings.s07.5: Cited span C-7aa58b9c302bbe supports the MDEQ nameplate restriction (1.24GW by July 2027), but 'TCEQ pauses' and 'JETI permit compliance' are not in the cited span.
